policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_week.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: WhatsApp is rolling out a new feature that allows users to invite people to in-app events even if they do not have the messenger installed, by sharing a link.
SoundCloud has integrated with ElevenLabs, enabling users to directly publish AI-generated music from ElevenLabs to SoundCloud, alongside offering Artist Pro subscribers three months free.
Discord has transitioned from Electron to a new web app, resulting in reduced RAM usage for the application.

world.summary: The pound has reached its highest value against other currencies since the Brexit referendum, following a decline in the dollar after the US midterm elections and the UK's efforts towards closer ties with the EU.
Multiple commercial flights across Europe were diverted due to reported bomb threats, though an EU transport commissioner stated it is too early to determine if the 19 incidents are linked.
Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong received a second jail term of 10 years under the city's security law, a sentence condemned by both the UK and US.

us.summary: Democrats have gained control of both the House and Senate in the US midterm elections, resulting in a significant shift in congressional power.
A new report indicates that first-time homebuyers are increasingly scarce, with a record 10% of them now paying for their homes entirely in cash.
House Speaker Mike Johnson will step aside as the top Republican in the House for the next Congress following the party's defeat in the recent midterm elections.

science.summary: A new study reveals that teenagers globally are not getting enough exercise, with girls showing particularly low rates of meeting recommended daily activity levels.
Researchers are garnering excitement with recent successes in using mRNA technology for cancer vaccines, offering new hope for patients and the medical community.
